note: Set B of the round-4 acceptance test (rule-jev-data-v2.md): 60 everyday questions written on 29 Sep 2026 by a separate Claude Code session given only the two models' table, column and measure names (fresh-r4-writer.md, the fresh-r3 input word for word), 35 on Northstar and 25 on Contoso asked of both copies: 85 items. Labelled by the round-4 verifier before any run, for the full UAT fixture (Northstar data 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2025). Run once, live, through JevQueryReplay. Questions that repeat an earlier set word for word are kept and flagged ('repeat'), the fresh3 way.
grading: As set A (verify-r4/set-a-labels.json 'grading'): right, harmful (HIGH or MEDIUM by the item's harm list, else by the rule), asked (fair when askOk, else needless, by cause), refused.
